feeds.title: The CRNA Chase Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kiki Mattress. I am a board-certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA) practicing in SC. My journey to nurse anesthesia school was long and hard but eventually, I made it. Therefore, my desire is to help others by sharing all that I have learned over the years to make the journey less bumpy. I hope this platform will help you navigate your way through the nurse anesthesia school admissions process.

feeds.title: Texas Association of Nurse Anesthetists News
feeds.description: Find the latest news and events updates. The Texas Association of Nurse Anesthetists (TxANA) was founded on August 9, 1974. Its goals include facilitating cooperation between nurse anesthetists and the medical profession, hospitals, healthcare providers, and other agencies interested in anesthesia.

feeds.title: Nurse Jess CRNA Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jessica. I'm currently a certified registered nurse anesthetist and I'm writing this blog to give my readers insight into nurse anesthesia and nursing as a profession.

feeds.title: Allegheny Anesthetists Blog
feeds.description: Allegheny Anesthetists provides qualified, credentialed Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs) to healthcare facilities. Let us help meet your needs!

feeds.title: Everything CRNA
feeds.description: My name is Nelson and I'm a 100% real CRNA in NYC. I hope to provide practical, insightful, easy-to-understand articles and services to help you achieve success in the professions of Nurse Anesthetists and Anesthesiologist Assistants.
